units.source_text: 源氏公子回到了二条院，

en.t: Prince Genji returned to the Nijo residence,

units.source_text: 独自躺下寻思：“在这世间要找一个称心合意的人，真不容易啊！”

en.t: and lay down alone, thinking, "How hard it is in this world to find someone truly to one's liking!"

units.source_text: 他想起对方是个身份高贵的人，

en.t: When he remembered that she was a person of high rank,

units.source_text: 就此抛开了她，毕竟不好意思。

en.t: he felt it would be shameful after all to cast her aside just like that.
His thoughts wandered restlessly, and his heart was troubled.
